name: Agfachrome RSX II 100 Professional
source: Agfa-Gevaert AG, Technical Data: Agfa Professional Films, publication F-PF-E4 (2003-07), page 8

notes.characteristic: Colour density curves: daylight exposure 1/100 s, process AP 44/E-6, Status A and Status M densitometry (not specified per film); x is lg exposure (lx s).
notes.sensitivity: Equal-energy spectrum, reading density 1.0 above minimum density; y is lg sensitivity (relative).
notes.dye_density: Absorption of the emulsion dyes for a neutral subject of medium brightness: yellow, magenta, cyan and visual grey. Agfachrome colour balance is designed for ISO 3664 viewing light (5000 K).

grain.note: Granularity (x 1000): RMS 10.0; daylight exposure, visual filter (V lambda), diffuse density 1.0, 48 um reading aperture.
